column1: # What the alternation reaches with names people actually use.
# The 320 quoted elsewhere in this spike is a property of the FIXTURE's short
# names (lora-budget / model-a / adapter-a1), not of the shape. Adapter and
# namespace names in real deployments are two to three times longer, and both the
# 4096-byte header cap and the RE2 program-size limit are byte-driven.
# Envoy's stock RE2 program-size limit is 100 and program size tracks literal
# bytes almost 1:1, so the pattern may be about 100 characters on a default
# Envoy. publishers/{namespace}/models/ alone costs 30-45 of that.
# MEASURED on the cluster, three data planes, realistic profile
